remarks: Welcome to the 2026 Flora by Bedrock Homes! Located in the scenic community of Riverstead at Keswick, this stunning 1,592 sqft home blends modern functionality with elegant design. The main floor features a versatile front-facing flex room, ideal for a home office, studio, or playroom. The open-concept great room, complete with a cozy 50” electric fireplace, flows seamlessly into a dining area and a designer corner kitchen featuring quartz countertops, an island with an eating bar, a corner pantry and a picturesque window above the sink. A convenient powder room and rear mudroom complete this level. Upstairs, you’ll find a central bonus room, laundry room, two spacious bedrooms, and a primary suite featuring a 3-piece ensuite and a walk-in closet. Perfectly designed for comfort and modern living, the Flora is ready to welcome you home. (id:67522)
